YTMP.Title: YouTube Music Player
YTMP.ClickToEnable: Your browser blocked autoplay. Click anywhere to start the GM's music.
YTMP.PasteHint: Paste a YouTube video or playlist link below.
YTMP.ClearQueueConfirm: Remove every track from the queue?
YTMP.AppendList: Append this saved playlist to the queue
YTMP.NoSavedPlaylists: No saved playlists yet. Use the save icon on the queue.
YTMP.InvalidLink: That doesn't look like a YouTube video or playlist link.
YTMP.PlaylistFallback: Couldn't read the playlist; adding just the linked video.

Error.Html5: "{title}" can't be played in this browser's HTML5 player.
Error.NotFound: "{title}" was removed or is private. Skipping.
Error.NoEmbed: "{title}" doesn't allow playback outside YouTube. Skipping.

Broadcast.Name: Broadcast GM music to players
Broadcast.Hint: When on, the GM's player is played on every player's computer, in sync. Players control their own volume. When off, everyone gets a private player.

Listen.Name: Listen to the GM's music
Listen.Hint: Turn off to mute the GM's broadcast on this computer and use a private player instead.

ShowVideo.Name: Show video
ShowVideo.Hint: Show a small YouTube video window in the corner of the screen.

NoCookie.Name: Use youtube-nocookie.com
NoCookie.Hint: Embed through YouTube's privacy-enhanced domain. Can help when Firefox's strict tracking protection or a content blocker interferes with the player.
